newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka shares ease after rally.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka shares ease after rally.

text.p: Dhaka stocks had gains in all but one in the past week and brokers said a market correction was setting in to end a lingering rally.
Baring some institutional selling there was huge buying interest demonstrated by small and retail investors thanks to the country's political stability.
A market analyst said Thursday's correction might extend when the market reopened after Moslem Friday weekend as "buyers may ask for a lower price."
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) index gained 92.36 points in the week to 1,665.02 in the week ending on Thursday.
